summary: Tested electronic signature end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite tests/test_signed_docs.py, 15/15 passed (run with -n0 because tests share state). It covers the template, doctor signing and superseding a previous consent, PDF SHA-256 matching file_sha256, the PDF's /Encrypt and no-modify permission, and the PDF content (signer, informativa, clauses, image, legal box with FIR- code, IP, device, SHA-256). It also covers the paper form PDF, the modulo_cartaceo method creating no document, validation (400/400/422/404), revoke marking the document revoked, public verify (valid, revoked, random, non-hex, paper form), the doctor signature cycle (GET/PUT/report PDF 'Firmato elettronicamente il'/DELETE, invalid 400, parent 403), portal template/sign/me/pdf, and parent isolation (404/403). Frontend: doctor Passport > Privacy tab works: informativa comes from the backend, paper form downloads Modulo_consenso_Leonardo_Colombo.pdf, tablet signing shows a toast with the PDF code, the list shows 'Valido' and 'PDF firmato' downloads a file whose SHA matches. Area riservata 'Firma per i referti': open, 'Firma del Medico' modal, preview and date, Rifirma and Rimuovi all work, and the report PDF FIRMA box shows the image and date. Portal at 1440: banner, dialog, signature, submit, toast, banner disappears, Consensi tab shows the doc and it downloads. Portal at 390 with real CDP touch events (pointerType touch) completed the same flow with no horizontal overflow. /verifica: signed PDF shows valid with the code, paper form and report show invalid, and a superseded doc shows the revoked notice.

critical.issue: The client IP is read from the FIRST X-Forwarded-For entry, which the client controls. Reproduced: POST /api/signatures with header 'X-Forwarded-For: 6.6.6.6' put 6.6.6.6 into the PDF legal box ('Indirizzo IP'). A forged IP weakens the signature evidence, and the 30/hour verify rate limit can be bypassed by rotating the header. Use the entry added by the trusted ingress (rightmost / last trusted hop) or X-Real-IP set by the ingress.

minor.issue: Response returns the full signature PNG data URL (Consent.out includes 'signature'). This bloats the payload and needlessly exposes biometric-like data. Omit it.

Not atomic: the previous consents and docs are revoked before the PDF is built and archived. If build_consent_pdf or the insert fails, the patient is left with a new consent but no document. Build the PDF first, then revoke and insert.
Rate-limit state is kept in process memory ('hits' dict). It resets on restart, is not shared across workers and grows without bound per IP key. Consider a Mongo TTL collection.

ui_bugs.issue: ref.current.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) is not wrapped in try/catch and is called after active.current is set. If capture throws (InvalidPointerId, seen with synthetic pointer events), no stroke is pushed. Every pointermove then crashes in move() reading s.length of undefined (24 runtime errors, app error overlay). Real touch, mouse and pen work fine. Harden it: wrap in try/catch, push the stroke before capture, and guard 'if (!s) return' in move.

issues: The LogoMark in the top-left renders as an almost empty white square (monogram barely visible) on the dark background.

design_issues.screen: Area riservata > Firma per i referti

'Firmato elettronicamente il 21/10/2026 alle 10:20' wraps so the time sits alone on the next line. Consider a shorter label or a wider cell.

rca of the issue: IP spoofing: client_meta takes request.headers['x-forwarded-for'].split(',')[0]. The ingress appends the real IP, so a client-supplied value always comes first. Reproduced with requests header X-Forwarded-For: 6.6.6.6, which then appeared in the PDF legal box. Mitigation: take the ingress-appended entry (rightmost minus the number of trusted proxies) or a trusted X-Real-IP.
